text: As an OlderPerson, I want to have a very good battery for ALFRED so I can keep him on the whole day.
alasan: "Very good battery" tidak punya kriteria terukur (berapa jam?), jadi sulit diuji.

category: 7. Emergency Handling, Fall Detection & Caregiver Calls
text: As an OlderPerson, I want to use ALFRED to contact help in case of an emergency.
alasan: Terlalu umum ("contact help in emergency") dan tumpang tindih dengan story 49, 50, 52 di kategori Emergency Handling, jadi tidak berdiri sendiri.

text: As a MedicalCaregiver, I want to have ALFRED to propose me games that require the combination of mental and physical exercise, such as opposing motion exercises of the arms and legs.
alasan: Hampir sama persis dengan story 74 (aktor beda), padahal story 74 dinilai I=0 oleh A. B konsisten: keduanya tumpang tindih.

text: As an OlderPerson, I want to use ALFRED for navigation.
alasan: "Use ALFRED for navigation" adalah epic yang mencakup story 86, 88, 89 di kategori yang sama.

text: As an OlderPerson, I want to use ALFRED to control the heating.
alasan: Kontrol pemanas tidak bergantung pada story lain di Smart Home (pintu, lampu, TV). Paralel dengan story 109 yang dinilai I=1 oleh A.

category: 15. App Marketplace Ecosystem & Developer Platform (ALFREDO Platform & API)
text: As a developer, I want to be notified as soon as possible when the state of any of my Apps changes.
alasan: "As soon as possible" tidak punya batas waktu konkret, sehingga tidak ada kriteria lulus/gagal yang jelas.

category: 3. Archival Description, Resource & Component Record Management
text: As an Archivist, I want to create and edit a Resource record.
alasan: "Create and edit a Resource record" bertumpuk dengan story 18 (create/update/delete archival descriptions) dan 19 di kategori yang sama.

text: As an Archivist, I want to rearrange the resource description hierarchy by dragging an archival object to a different position in the hierarchy.
alasan: Fungsinya sama dengan story 24 (rearrange hierarchy), hanya beda cara interaksi (drag vs keyboard), jadi saling tumpang tindih.

text: As an archivist, I want to search within a repository for resource and accession and digital object records.
alasan: Mencari di tiga jenis record sekaligus (resource, accession, digital object), terlalu besar untuk satu story.

text: As a trainee, I want to must accept the cancellation terms with a checkbox, so that they can be accountable..
alasan: Persetujuan syarat pembatalan punya nilai bisnis nyata (akuntabilitas, mengurangi sengketa refund), jadi B menilai ada value.

text: As a anonymoususer, I want to have a training landing page with an intro section and a list of all training offerings and promote call for trainings, so that I can shop for training all with one page and we can have a call for trainings for selection.
alasan: Memuat tiga hal sekaligus: intro section, daftar semua training, dan promosi call for trainings.

text: As a anonymoususer, I want to see specific details on summits, so that I can learn more about the summit I'm interested in to see if it matches my interests, register for the event, and get day-of knowledge to help me get to the location.
alasan: Memuat tiga tujuan sekaligus (mempelajari summit, mendaftar, info hari-H), seharusnya dipecah.

text: As a authenticateduser, I want to find a link on the sponsorships page to become a $350 level sponsor, so that I can pay for and become a sponsor role.
alasan: Menetapkan solusi UI spesifik (link di halaman sponsorship) dan nominal $350, mengurangi ruang negosiasi.

text: As a anonymoususer, I want to easily find a link in the menu that links to the registration form, so that I can easily register for the camp.
alasan: Menetapkan lokasi UI ("link in the menu"), padahal kebutuhannya hanya agar mudah menemukan form registrasi.

text: As a Cornell faculty member, I want to upload data to the repository and associate it with a publication, so that I receive attribution for my data as well as my publications.
alasan: Upload data + kaitkan ke publikasi tumpang tindih dengan story upload lain di kategori yang sama (3, 4, 9).

text: As a library staff member, I want to create a collection, sometimes with custom metadata fields, so that I can house digital material for wider distribution.
alasan: "Create a collection" sudah dicakup story 24 dan 25 di kategori Collections.

category: 6. Document Versioning, Naming & Historical Report Relationships
text: As a DB/IR administrator, I want to upload new version of report/dataset while retaining previous versions for patron use.
alasan: Upload versi baru sambil menyimpan versi lama sama dengan story 59 dan 60 (duplikat) di kategori yang sama.

category: 11. Digital Preservation, Asset Safety & Storage Redundancy (Digital Preservation & Asset Safety)
text: As an asset manager, I want to be assured that the digital copy I deposit is stored redundantly, so that when one copy suffers destruction or unwanted changes, I still have other good copies to restore from.
alasan: Penyimpanan redundan bertumpuk dengan story 94 (monitoring salinan redundan) di kategori Preservation.

text: As a Publisher, I want to sign up for an account, so that that I can publish my data package to the registry and to have a publisher account to publish my data package under.
alasan: "Sign up for an account" tumpang tindih dengan story 2 (sign up via github/google).

text: As an Owner, I want to invite an existing user, so that the user can become a member of my publisher.
alasan: Mengundang user existing tumpang tindih dengan story 12 (mengundang via email) di kategori yang sama.

text: As a Publisher, I want to publish a dataset, so that I can share the dataset publicly with everyone.
alasan: Teks identik dengan story 25 ("publish a dataset"), hanya beda tujuan, jadi tidak independen.

text: As a Consumer, I want to view a data package online, so that I can get a sense of whether this is the dataset I want.
alasan: Hampir identik dengan story 37 ("view a data package"), yang dinilai I=0 oleh A. B konsisten.

text: As a user, I want to list all the collections and objects in the DAMS that belong to a library unit.
alasan: Daftar collection dan object tumpang tindih dengan story 1 dan 2 di kategori yang sama.

category: 1. Access Control, File Restriction & Confidentiality (Access Restriction & Redaction)
text: As an archivist, I want to restrict access to some files by IP address, so that I can give reading room access only to certain digital files.
alasan: Mewajibkan mekanisme pembatasan berbasis IP address, itu solusi teknis, bukan kebutuhan.

text: As a depositor, I want to deposit and maintain datasets through a simple web interface, so that I don't need to install and learn new software to deposit.
alasan: "Deposit and maintain datasets" juga dicakup story 3 dan 4 (lewat Pure dan VRE).

category: 1. Music Search, Discovery & Recommendation (Audio Discovery & Music Recommendation)
text: As a user, I want to search and discover music based on my profile.
alasan: Search & discover music berdasarkan profil adalah variasi dari story 1, 3, 4, 5 dengan tujuan yang sama.
